status: Public source prerelease and website live; v0.1.15-alpha.1 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB, Wi-Fi, an always-on relay and phone-only setup; native Grok Bot calls observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: The v0.1.15-alpha.1 hub release candidate records gateway 0.1.0a14 on PyPI (owner-approved trusted publishing on 14 October 2026; files match the GitHub release's SHA256SUMS) with ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.15, Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.6 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. Adds ADR 010 (accepted), the phone setup and factory-provision guides, the Tell me when guide and the Phase 10 record. On 14 October 2026 the owner joined the factory-provisioned kit to home Wi-Fi from an iPhone and an Android phone with the computer closed; it went Online through the relay and Grok Bot on the iPhone showed text on it (hub docs/verification/phone-setup-2026-10-14.md). One kit; independent reproduction is not claimed.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; LAN and relay device listeners and factory-provision used by one physical kit; native Grok Bot calls through serve --oauth observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: 313 tests (Python 3.11 to 3.14), Ruff, the first-success path in both MCP eras and the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed; PyPI 0.1.0a14 matches SHA256SUMS. Adds rehearse --protocol for the initialize and 2026-07-28 eras, honest CIMD metadata, device port 8444 for new relays, relay-check, and factory-provision with setup labels. On 14 October 2026 relay-check passed against the owner's relay and factory-provision prepared the owner's kit for phone setup (hub docs/verification/phone-setup-2026-10-14.md). The relay itself still runs 0.1.0a13.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests against gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10; Ruff, package builds and twine check passed. The gateway extra pins gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10, so the SDK and its gateway install from PyPI. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Host CTest suites (12/12, including wifi_factory and wifi_setup), the contract check and four firmware builds passed. Alpha.15 separates the factory identity from user Wi-Fi settings and adds the setup hotspot with a captive page (RAM 108,076 B, flash 932,617 B on the Wi-Fi build). On 14 October 2026 the owner's kit joined home Wi-Fi from an iPhone and an Android phone through its setup hotspot; a wrong setup code was refused, a wrong password was shown, the window expired and BOOT resets re-joined (hub docs/verification/phone-setup-2026-10-14.md).

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.

firmware.status: build verified; hardware and Grok pending; unpublished
